files.description: Complete EHI Export Data Table Definitions page — a self-contained HTML data dictionary documenting 309 tables and 4,481 fields exported in PCIS GOLD's tab-delimited EHI export format. Last updated 10/27/2023.
Browser screenshot of the EHI export documentation page showing the title, introductory text, and table-of-contents index.

Bun TypeScript enrichment script that parses the HTML data dictionary into queryable JSON. Extracts all 309 table definitions with their fields, computes domain categorizations, and generates parsing statistics.
Full extraction of all 309 table definitions with 4,481 fields. Each table has name, anchor, description, and fields array (name, type, description). Primary enrichment artifact.
Lightweight table index: table name, description, and field count for all 309 tables.
Parsing statistics: total tables (309), total fields (4,481), zero parse failures, field type distribution, and heuristic domain categorization of tables into 37 categories.
Enrichment README with run commands, input/output description, and known parsing limitations.
